sections.h: What TinyCare is — and is not
p: TinyCare offers general educational information and record-keeping tools for postpartum recovery, child growth, vaccinations, nutrition and play.

It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Vaccination dates are based on India's Universal Immunisation Programme and are a guide only; your doctor or health worker decides what is right for you and your child.
If you think you or your child may have a medical emergency, call your doctor or go to the nearest hospital immediately.
You are responsible for keeping your password and device secure. Information you enter should be accurate and about you or children in your care.
Data is stored on your device only. We cannot recover data or reset a forgotten password.

If your version of the app is connected to a TinyCare server, your account and records are also stored there so you can sign in on other devices. You can delete the account, including the server copy, at any time from Settings.
Do not misuse the app, attempt to break its security, or use it to harm others. Use it only for lawful, personal and family care purposes.
The app, its design and its original content belong to its owner. You keep ownership of the information you enter.
